item.title: Marine World Uminonakamichi Aquarium — Guide
item.description: Marine World Uminonakamichi is Fukuoka’s main aquarium, set on the scenic Uminonakamichi sandbar that stretches across Hakata Bay. Its focus is the marine life of the seas around Kyushu, especially the waters warmed by the Tsushima current, displayed in a large tank recreating the Genkai Sea and home to sharks, rays and shoals of fish. Highlights include a big shark collection, playful dolphins and sea lions with regular shows, penguins, and hands-on touch pools, making it especially popular with families.

item.title: Uminonakamichi Seaside Park — Guide
item.description: Uminonakamichi Seaside Park is an enormous national government park spread across the scenic Uminonakamichi sandbar that stretches into Hakata Bay, offering a full day of nature and family fun. Its highlight is the seasonal flower gardens, which blaze with colour through the year — nemophila and tulips in spring, sunflowers and roses in summer, cosmos and kochia in autumn — creating spectacular flower carpets and photo spots. Alongside the flowers, the vast grounds hold a small animal park and petting zoo, a summer water park with pools and slides, wide lawns, cycling paths with rental bikes, and sea views.
